title: Client Mode Driver Is on the Wrong Host
description:
**SITUATION:**

Same YARN cluster as the rest of Chapter 2. Overnight an unattended rollup ran in **client** deploy mode — the Spark driver lived on `shell`. Mid-job that edge process disappeared and the application died. The lasting submit path `~/lab/submit-store-rollup.sh` still looks like that overnight shape.

Platform policy: unattended jobs use **cluster** deploy mode (driver is a YARN ApplicationMaster on a NodeManager), and input data lives on the cluster shared mount **`/mnt/lab-shared`** (same path on shell and every NodeManager). Today the CSVs only exist under `~/lab/edge-data/` on the shell.

**YOUR TASK:**

1. Inspect the failed overnight application and the wrapper / job on disk. Record why the overnight run died.
2. Move the lasting path to cluster deploy mode. Run it — expect a **second** break once the driver is no longer on shell.
3. Put the CSVs where every host can see them (`/mnt/lab-shared/...`), point `~/lab/store_rollup.py` at those paths, and re-run until the job finishes.
4. Record the successful application id and which NodeManager held the AM/driver.
5. Fill Investigation in story order, then Submit.

**SPEC:**

- `~/lab/submit-store-rollup.sh` uses `--deploy-mode cluster` (not client).
- `~/lab/store_rollup.py` reads CSVs from `/mnt/lab-shared` (not `~/lab/edge-data`).
- Shared rollup CSVs exist under `/mnt/lab-shared/rollup/`.
- A successful application is RUNNING or FINISHED; AM/driver host is `ds-spark-02` or `ds-spark-03`.
- Investigation matches the overnight failure and the second break.

hints: Failed overnight id is in ~/lab/failed_app_id. Client mode puts the Spark driver on shell — kill that process and the app dies.
Repair ~/lab/submit-store-rollup.sh to --deploy-mode cluster, then run it. Read yarn logs if the driver is no longer printing to your terminal.
Cluster-mode driver runs on a NodeManager — it cannot see /home/spark/lab/edge-data on shell.
Copy the CSVs to /mnt/lab-shared/rollup/ (shared on every host) and point store_rollup.py at file:///mnt/lab-shared/rollup/....
Fill the Investigation tab — missing answers fail on Submit.
